# Workspace (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Workspace settings, people and your account.

## Files

- `AccountPage.vue`: Your account: display name, password, and where you are signed in.
- `UsersPage.vue`: People and roles (admin only): add people, change roles, reset passwords, disable accounts.
- `WorkspacePage.vue`: Workspace settings: what applies to every engagement.
